cluster_rules_on_known_addresses.method: Precision of the clustering rules on addresses whose entity is known without them: addresses from an official address list, and addresses linked through a Lista or Silo vault listing. Each is treated as unknown and the rule's prediction, made only from official anchors and never from an anchor at the same address, is compared with the known entity. The same-address rule is tested only between Morpho's per-chain listings, because euler-labels lists an address once for every chain.

euler_labels.compared: product governing entity (first entry of products.json 'entity') against our current interval for lending vaults

morpho_api.compared: API vault-level curator labels (V1 state.curators, V2 curators) against our current interval
morpho_api.independence: the API derives vault labels by matching the vault's current curator and owner against its own curator registry, the same registry our official rule uses; agreement under other rules is the independent part
